content.text: That sounds brutal, and two hours of screaming at 1am would wreck anyone. Long screaming stretches like that are fairly common at 28 months, and some kids are hard to settle or even to wake during them. Tonight, try staying calm in the room with him with the lights low. Skip talking or picking him up unless he reaches for you, and keep an eye on his safety. If he ever seems hurt or feverish, call 811, or 911 if it's an emergency.
